B0.name: Memoryless Rehabilitation (Frozen Baseline)
B0.description: Paper 1 TrustEngine unchanged. Accumulator clears to zero; trust recovers with fixed alpha = 0.2057; policy mapping is memoryless.

M1.name: Persistent Evidence Floor
M1.description: Retains a bounded fraction of accumulated slow-burn suspicion as an evidentiary floor h_t, preventing SB from completely zeroing across cycles.
M1.state_vector: (T, E, SB, h) in [0, 1] x [0, 1] x [0, inf) x [0, h_max]
M1.update_rule: h_{t+1} = min(h_max, max(h_t, kappa * SB_{accum})) if E > gamma else max(0, h_t - delta_h)

M2.name: History-Dependent Recovery Rate
M2.description: Dynamically scales the trust recovery rate alpha as a function of cumulative adverse incidents k_inc. Preserves alpha > 0 for all finite k.
M2.state_vector: (T, E, SB, k_inc, clean_counter) in [0, 1] x [0, 1] x [0, inf) x {0..k_max} x {0..n_clean_req}
M2.new_state_variables: k_inc: Incident counter; clean_counter: Continuous ALLOW streak counter
M2.incident_update: k_inc increments when policy drops from ALLOW; decrements when clean_counter reaches n_clean_req

M3.name: Rehabilitation Hysteresis
M3.description: Imposes temporal hysteresis on policy restoration. When trust drops, device enters probation; re-attaining ALLOW requires H_req consecutive clean steps.
M3.state_vector: (T, E, SB, probation, streak) in [0, 1] x [0, 1] x [0, inf) x {0, 1} x {0..H_req}
M3.new_state_variables: probation in {0, 1}; streak: consecutive clean steps (A < A_thr and E <= gamma)
M3.hysteresis_rule: Policy is VERIFY while probation == 1, even if T >= T_ALLOW. Probation clears only when streak >= H_req.
